actions.title: Read the private capstone boundary
actions.instruction: Read this private-source lesson before starting. Preview 0.19 does not prepare, evaluate, or publish U07; its detailed workflow becomes usable only with a future accepted fixture and tool release.
actions.rationale: A capstone must not make source material look like a runnable public route.
actions.expected_result: You understand that Preview refuses U07 and that the later cards are a future private-source walkthrough.
actions.recovery: Use a published Preview 0.19 lab instead. Do not create an Academy branch, route, or evidence file to bypass the boundary.
actions.evidence: Preview manifest exclusion and the installed-tool refusal.

actions.title: Observe the current Prepare refusal
actions.instruction: Run one installed Academy Prepare command only to confirm that Preview 0.19 still fails closed for U07.
actions.rationale: The public tool must not create a capstone attempt until its complete guided contract is accepted.
actions.expected_result: Academy reports that U07 is not published or guided, exits nonzero, and creates no attempt.
actions.recovery: Preserve the refusal and continue with a published lab. Never manufacture a capstone branch or scenario record.
actions.evidence: The nonzero refusal and unchanged Git status.

actions.title: Future private-source: read the bounded brief
actions.instruction: Future private-source walkthrough only: read the prepared Workshop Queue brief. It names one constrained resolution-validation change and its allowed code and test paths.
actions.rationale: One bounded change makes the capstone inspectable instead of rewarding an unverifiable broad rewrite.
actions.expected_result: You can name the approved change, its allowed implementation paths, and the local evidence sequence.
actions.recovery: If the brief asks for a different task or broad cleanup, stop and start a new prepared attempt rather than widening scope.
actions.evidence: The future fixture binds the brief and its allowed paths to the prepared attempt.

actions.title: Future private-source: run the governed feature lane
actions.instruction: Future private-source walkthrough only: invoke the host-native feature lane for `Reject control characters in ticket resolutions`. Complete its real spec, plan, test-first, commit, and pull-request terminal gates; keep the regression and implementation as separate commits.
actions.rationale: The capstone practices the real feature pipeline while separating local Check evidence from the hosted PR terminal that the plugin actually requires.
actions.expected_result: The future attempt contains a feature-derived spec and plan plus separate regression and implementation commits, then the plugin's real pull-request terminal.
actions.recovery: If the feature lane skips a review gate, changes an unapproved path, or cannot open its required pull request, preserve the attempt and Reset. Do not rewrite history to conceal it.
actions.evidence: Future Check inspects only local committed paths, parentage, remotes, focused test behavior, and cleanliness. It never treats the command invocation or hosted pull-request result as proof.

actions.title: Future private-source: record the decision
actions.instruction: Future private-source walkthrough only: after the learner chooses the validation boundary, use the host-native ADR command to record that decision with the learner's attribution. Commit the generated ADR with the feature spec and plan.
actions.rationale: A decision-worthy validation boundary belongs in the real numbered ADR lifecycle, not in an Academy-shaped substitute.
actions.expected_result: The real ADR lifecycle writes one numbered decision record describing the chosen validation boundary.
actions.recovery: If the learner has not made the decision, stop for that attribution. Do not invent an accepted ADR or copy an Academy template.
actions.evidence: The committed ADR is in `.codearbiter/decisions/` alongside the feature spec and plan.

actions.title: Future private-source: run the local review
actions.instruction: Future private-source walkthrough only: review the focused local diff after the implementation commit. Resolve any blocking finding before advancing, but do not create a review report because the real command is read-only.
actions.rationale: The course teaches the actual reviewer-fleet boundary instead of fabricating an artifact it does not produce.
actions.expected_result: The reviewer fleet returns a local, read-only triaged verdict and writes no review receipt.
actions.recovery: If a critical or high finding remains, preserve the diff and return to the governed feature work. Do not write an Academy review JSON to simulate a verdict.
actions.evidence: The live review output is advisory and ephemeral; future Check verifies only repository-derived facts.

actions.title: Observe the current Check refusal
actions.instruction: Run one installed Academy Check command only to confirm that Preview 0.19 keeps U07 unavailable until the complete contract is accepted and promoted.
actions.rationale: The public checker must not accept an unpublished capstone.
actions.expected_result: Academy reports that U07 is not published or guided, exits nonzero, and does not modify the repository.
actions.recovery: Keep the refusal as public-boundary evidence and return to a published lab.
actions.evidence: Refusal output and unchanged Git status.
